cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You're my deputy. You'll answer the inspector's complaints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Most of them concern decisions you made.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Exactly. You handle the details below decision-making level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The inspector wants whoever signs the replies at tomorrow's hearing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign as deputy, then. You can represent me without giving the impression we're equals.

mechanism: A misunderstands and copies a rank cue, then uses the resulting hierarchy to give B an unwanted job.
confusable: D49 seeks help as deputy; D53 specifically offloads an unwanted responsibility by putting B below A.
comparison: Event cleanup after promotion versus responding to inspection complaints.
seedUse: Preserve the inconvenient late plumber and hearing requirement; give rank imitation a clear origin.
